Title: Multi-step web tests will be retired on 31 August 2024

Body.Content:
Multi-step web tests depend on Visual Studio webtest files, and it has been announced that Visual Studio 2019 will be the last version with webtest functionality. Therefore, we are retiring multi-step web tests within Application Insights on 31 August 2024.  
 
We recommend using TrackAvailability() to submit custom availability tests instead of multi-step web tests. With TrackAvailability() and custom availability tests, you can run tests on any compute you want and use C# to easily author new tests.  

You won’t be able to create new multi-step web tests after 31 August 2023. 

Recommended action

  • Rewrite your existing multi-step web tests as custom availability tests before 31 August 2024.

Help and support

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
